'''2010 US East Nationals John Anderson LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' John Anderson (Puck71)
* '''Deck name:''' Boring
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
